They remain consistent with T-041, T-008 and TB-002, and none is invalidated. Integration questions remain unverified from this diff alone. Neither is a security regression on the evidence supplied. Neither the Swift sources nor the cited line 2126 on the head side were visible to me, so I raise no finding.
